# CerebroHive

> CerebroHive architects enterprise AI systems — AI strategy, platform engineering, AI agents, RAG, knowledge engineering, and AI governance — for organizations across 16+ industries including finance, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, government, insurance, and energy.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://cerebro-hive.com/services): Full enterprise AI services catalog, priced per engagement.
- [AI Strategy](https://cerebro-hive.com/services/strategy): Roadmaps, readiness assessments, and AI governance framework design.
- [AI Engineering](https://cerebro-hive.com/services/engineering): Enterprise RAG, knowledge graphs, custom agents, and platform deployment.
- [AI Operations](https://cerebro-hive.com/services/operations): Ongoing operations, monitoring, and optimization for AI systems in production.
- [Security & Governance](https://cerebro-hive.com/services/security): Security architecture and compliance support for enterprise AI programs.
- [Industry Solutions](https://cerebro-hive.com/services/industry): Vertical-specific AI programs.

## Platform

- [Platform overview](https://cerebro-hive.com/platform): 51 integrated capabilities spanning data, models, agents, governance, and operations.
- [Industries](https://cerebro-hive.com/industries): AI programs for finance, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, government, insurance, energy, construction, real estate, logistics, education, telecom, technology, media, and professional services.
- [Solutions](https://cerebro-hive.com/solutions): Packaged solutions covering enterprise AI, AI agents, RAG, document AI, knowledge management, hyperautomation, decision intelligence, predictive analytics, customer experience, ERP modernization, cloud modernization, and AI governance.
